Each delta is rank-1 (top1 singular share 0.97-0.98, participation ratio ~1.0-1.1); per-tensor SVD extracts (sigma1, u1, v1). Re-application W' = W + sigma1*u1*v1^T on a fresh base (52/52 applied, 0 skipped) reproduces the reference at rel_mad 0.0234 -> 0.0061 (Q8 noise floor). All 52 edits share a single 2048-d left-singular direction u1 across the network (|cos| 0.96-0.99); layers 0-4 untouched; per-layer sigma1 graduates peaking ~L13-17.
